object:white-handed shield / Uruk-hai sh.visualDescription: A dark iron shield has a broad flat top, tapered point, and a large pale white hand motif.
object:white-handed shield / Uruk-hai sh.wikiDescription: The wiki says the Uruk-hai shield is iron armor appearing as a white-handed shield.
object:white-handed shield / Uruk-hai sh.modelBrief: Model a black-brown pointed shield with a centered pale handprint, using the mark as the main identifying detail.

object:red-eyed shield / orcish shield.visualDescription: A dark iron shield has a tapered outline and a bright red eye emblem in its center.
object:red-eyed shield / orcish shield.wikiDescription: The wiki says the orcish shield appears as a red-eyed iron shield when unidentified.
object:red-eyed shield / orcish shield.modelBrief: Build a simple pointed dark shield with one red eye symbol; keep the emblem flat and readable.

object:large shield.visualDescription: A tall iron shield has a rounded top, pointed bottom, dark rim, and broad red center panel.
object:large shield.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the large shield as heavy iron shield armor.
object:large shield.modelBrief: Make a broad body-height shield with iron border and vertical crimson inset, heavier than the small shields.

object:large round shield / dwarvish rou.visualDescription: A circular olive-gray shield has a thick outer ring and a small pale central boss.
object:large round shield / dwarvish rou.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the dwarvish roundshield as an iron shield appearing as a large round shield.
object:large round shield / dwarvish rou.modelBrief: Model a sturdy round shield with raised rim, muted metal face, and centered boss.

object:polished silver shield / shield o.visualDescription: A pale silver pointed shield has a thick reflective outer border and narrow dark central inset.
object:polished silver shield / shield o.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the shield of reflection as a silver magical shield with a polished silver appearance.
object:polished silver shield / shield o.modelBrief: Make a highly polished silver shield with clean bright edge and dark recessed center, avoiding painted magic symbols.

object:old gloves / leather gloves.visualDescription: A pair of brown leather gloves lies diagonally, one overlapping the other, with visible finger ridges.
object:old gloves / leather gloves.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies leather gloves as leather hand armor whose unidentified appearance can vary. This magical item can have another unidentified appearance when appearances are shuffled.
object:old gloves / leather gloves.modelBrief: Build a soft brown glove pair with stitched fingers and cuffs, matching the worn old-glove look. Keep the item identity separate from this appearance asset.

object:padded gloves / gauntlets of fumb.visualDescription: A bulky dark blue-gray gauntlet has padded back panels, finger seams, and heavy cuff.
object:padded gloves / gauntlets of fumb.wikiDescription: The wiki describes gauntlets of fumbling as magical leather gloves with a padded-glove default appearance. This magical item can have another unidentified appearance when appearances are shuffled.
object:padded gloves / gauntlets of fumb.modelBrief: Model a thick padded glove with dark blue-gray quilting and large cuff; represent fumbling through gameplay, not the mesh. Keep the item identity separate from this appearance asset.

object:riding gloves / gauntlets of powe.visualDescription: A pair of pale gray riding gauntlets has long cuffs, separate fingers, and dark outlines.
object:riding gloves / gauntlets of powe.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies gauntlets of power as iron gloves whose default unidentified appearance is riding gloves. This magical item can have another unidentified appearance when appearances are shuffled.
object:riding gloves / gauntlets of powe.modelBrief: Build long-cuffed gray riding gloves with articulated fingers and pale front panels. Match the visible appearance; choose actual material from the identified item at runtime.

object:fencing gloves / gauntlets of dex.visualDescription: A slender brown fencing glove lies diagonally with long narrow fingers and a soft cuff.
object:fencing gloves / gauntlets of dex.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies gauntlets of dexterity as magical leather gloves defaulting to fencing gloves. This magical item can have another unidentified appearance when appearances are shuffled.
object:fencing gloves / gauntlets of dex.modelBrief: Model a fitted brown glove with extended cuff and narrow fingers; keep dexterity as metadata. Keep the item identity separate from this appearance asset.

object:walking shoes / low boots.visualDescription: Two low brown walking shoes have short ankles, rounded toes, and darker soles.
object:walking shoes / low boots.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies low boots as leather footwear appearing as walking shoes.
object:walking shoes / low boots.modelBrief: Build a matched pair of ankle-high brown shoes with plain uppers and broad dark soles.

object:hard shoes / iron shoes.visualDescription: Two tall pale gray iron shoes have stiff upright shafts, hard toe caps, and dark interior openings.
object:hard shoes / iron shoes.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies iron shoes as metal footwear that appears as hard shoes.
object:hard shoes / iron shoes.modelBrief: Model a matched pair of rigid gray iron boots with squared shafts and heavy metal toes.

object:jackboots / high boots.visualDescription: A pair of high reddish-brown jackboots has tall shafts, black open tops, and lighter toe caps.
object:jackboots / high boots.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies high boots as leather footwear appearing as jackboots.
object:jackboots / high boots.modelBrief: Build knee-high dark brown boots with wide cuffs and rounded russet toe highlights.
